cites.quote: Re: Case No. 25-00082-UT El Paso Electric Company’s Application for Revision of its Retail Electric Rates Pursuant to Advice Notice No. 317

status.note: amended application filed 6 August 2026; the original application and Advice Notice No. 317 were filed 27 March 2026

threshold_mw.value: 10,000 kW Maximum Demand in the current month or the previous eleven months (no load factor requirement; the rate for large loads that do not meet Rate 50's); transmission voltage into a customer-dedicated substation

cites.quote: Service under this rate schedule shall be limited to Customers whose Maximum Demand, during the current month and previous eleven (11) month period, equaled or exceeded ten thousand (10,000) kilowatts (kW).
Service available under this rate schedule will be determined by the Company and will be three phase transmission voltage.
10+ MW and 30+ MW

min_demand.value: billing demand is the highest of on-peak or off-peak Maximum Demand, 80% of Contract Capacity, an 80% summer ratchet, or 10,000 kW; during the Load Ramp Period not less than 80% of the Load Ramp Contract Capacity; the Monthly Minimum Charge is the customer and demand charges, non-consumption riders, tax and any Facility Charge

cites.quote: (c) 80% of the Contract Capacity; or (d) the demand ratchet of 80% of the Maximum Demand established during the billing months
of June through September in the preceding twelve (12) month period; or (e) 10,000 kW.
monthly billing demand shall not be less than 80% of the customer’s Load Ramp Contract Capacity rather than 80% of the Contract Capacity
The Monthly Minimum Charge is the Customer Charge plus Demand Charge, Other NonConsumption Based Applicable Riders, Tax Adjustment, plus any applicable Facility Charge.

contract_term.value: Energy Service Agreement with a 20-year minimum initial term, automatic annual renewal after it; the Load Ramp Period, which cannot exceed 4 years, is included in the initial term; the ESA is filed with the PRC before service

cites.quote: Twenty (20) year minimum initial term, with automatic annual renewal after the Initial Term, as further provided in the ESA. The Load Ramp Period is included in the Initial Term Minimum.
The ESA must require that the Load Ramp Period cannot exceed 4 years.
which shall be filed by the Company with the New Mexico Public Regulation Commission prior to taking service under this rate schedule

collateral.value: none if the customer holds two of three ratings at A- (S&P), A3 (Moody's) or A- (Fitch); otherwise cash, an irrevocable standby letter of credit from an A-/A3 bank (365-day terms, renewed 30 days before expiry) or a parent or affiliate guarantee; Initial Security Amount set in the ESA on a dollar per MW basis of the requested maximum Monthly Contract Demand over the Initial Term; adjusted annually to the net present value of the customer's allocated revenue requirements for incremental generation and transmission for the rest of the term; replacement security within 30 days

cites.quote: then financial security will not be required
(1) Post of cash or cash equivalents. (2) An irrevocable standby letter of credit
(3) An irrevocable and unconditional guarantee from the ultimate parent or a corporate affiliate of the Customer
Security provided by the Customer shall be calculated on a dollar per MW basis of the requested maximum Monthly Contract Demand over the Initial Term and included in the Energy Service Agreement.
The Adjusted Security Amount will be equal to the net present value, using a discount rate equal to Company’s weighted average cost of capital

exit_fee.value: termination on an event of default before the end of the Initial Term may bring damages set in the ESA; customer-dedicated facility costs recovered in full through a Facility Charge set in the ESA

cites.quote: as the result of an Event of Default under the terms of the Energy Service Agreement or this rate schedule prior to the end of the Initial Term may be subject to damages as set forth in the Energy Services Agreement
